title: PathCostReport
description: The relative-cost estimate for a path, computed from architecture/execution_backend_pricebook.json (CONFIG, never hardcoded). backend_id names the pricebook backend the path runs on; estimated_cost is the relative-unit cost = request_cost + duration_cost_per_s * estimated_duration_s + idle_cost_per_s * estimated_idle_s. confidence is carried straight from the pricebook entry ('low' placeholder prices must never drive a production decision). pricebook_version pins the config the estimate came from so a cost decision is reproducible. cost_delta_vs_baseline (when present) is this path's estimated_cost minus the baseline path's, the number the promotion gate's cost_acceptable check reads. currency mirrors the pricebook ('relative-unit' offline).

path_id.description: the path this cost belongs to

backend_id.description: the pricebook backend key the path runs on (e.g. 'local_function_emulator@v1')

pricebook_version.description: the pricebook 'version' the estimate was computed from (reproducibility)

currency.description: mirrors the pricebook currency; offline ranking units, not real money

request_cost.description: the backend's per-request cost from the pricebook

duration_cost_per_s.description: the backend's per-second active cost from the pricebook

idle_cost_per_s.description: the backend's per-second idle/warm cost from the pricebook

estimated_duration_s.description: the injected/measured active duration used in the estimate (>= 0)

estimated_idle_s.description: the injected/measured idle/warm duration used in the estimate (>= 0)

cost_delta_vs_baseline.description: this path's estimated_cost minus the baseline's (negative = cheaper); feeds the promotion cost gate

confidence.description: carried from the pricebook entry; a 'low' placeholder must never drive a production cost decision
